title: Coefficients of a product of linear forms in one variable
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge1$, and $a_1,\dots,a_n,b_1,\dots,b_n\in R$. In the polynomial ring $R[t]$,

$$
\prod_{i=1}^n(a_it+b_i)=\sum_{j=0}^n\Bigl(\sum_{J\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\},\ |J|=j}\ \prod_{i\in J}a_i\prod_{i\notin J}b_i\Bigr)t^j .
$$

In particular (taking $R=\mathbf Z[x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n]$, $a_i=x_i$, $b_i=y_i$) the coefficient of $t^j$ in $\prod_i(x_it+y_i)$ is $\sum_{|J|=j}\prod_{i\in J}x_i\prod_{i\notin J}y_i$, and for every ring homomorphism $h:R\to R'$ the coefficients of $\prod_i(h(a_i)t+h(b_i))$ are the images under $h$ of those of $\prod_i(a_it+b_i)$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, proof of Lemma 0A4F (lemma-reduce-to-P1): 'F_0,...,F_n in x_1,...,y_n are the polynomials with integer coefficients such that prod (x_i t + y_i) = F_0 t^n + ... + F_n'; the explicit expansion is the distributive law (Vieta's formula in homogeneous form)

mathlib_match.how: specializes: in R[X] take s = Finset.range n (or univ of Fin n), f i = C a_i * X, g i = C b_i; then prod_{i in J} f i = C(prod_{i in J} a_i) * X^{#J} (Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Polynomial.C prod via map_prod), and grouping the powerset by cardinality (Finset.powerset_card_disjiUnion / Finset.sum_powerset_apply_card style regrouping, or reading coefficients with Polynomial.finset_sum_coeff and Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow) gives the coefficient of X^j as the sum over #J = j. The case a_i = 1 is Finset.prod_X_add_C_coeff (Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/Vieta.lean:67). The compatibility with ring homomorphisms is Polynomial.coeff_map with Polynomial.map_prod.
